# Keys you hand over - qa-retro-analyst

## Outputs

- `retro.md` - prose by the role over numbers code computed; `numbers` mode writes it by code alone
- `project:obligations.md` - the only carrier between stories
- `project:factory-backlog.md` - what the factory owes itself

Required at your stop (stage S9): `retro.md`.

## Witness

Your witness artifact (stages.json `witness`): `retro.md`.

## Handoff form

Contract `s9-retro-to-project` (fill `work/handoffs/<dispatch>.yaml`; `handoff_check.py` reads it):

- `inputs_read[].version` (required) - hash
- `inputs_read[].decisions_folded` (required) - n
- `header.window` (required) - TICKET
- `header.verdict` (required) - one of vocabulary.header_verdicts
- `retro_mode` (required) - one of vocabulary.retro_modes - full|numbers|skip
- `feedback.answer` (optional) - their words, verbatim, or `declined`
- `scope[].id` (required) - obligation id
- `scope[].state` (required) - filed|routed|deferred|not_executed
- `scope[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `scope[].text` (required) - one line - what is owed
- `scope[].trigger` (required) - what makes the next story pick it up - an area, a file, a ticket type, a date
- `scope[].owner` (required) - factory|person|team
- `knowledge_fold[].fact` (required) - one line - the trap, the term, the stand quirk, the owner's answer
- `knowledge_fold[].kind` (required) - code_trap|run_trap|planning_trap|term|stand_quirk|gate_answer
- `knowledge_fold[].document` (required) - project:strategy/framework-rules.md | project:strategy/test-strategy.md | project:strategy/faq.md | project:project-profile.md | project:glossary.md
- `knowledge_fold[].written` (required) - true|false
- `knowledge_fold[].as_proposal_in_report` (required) - true|false
- `factory_backlog[].id` (required) - backlog id
- `factory_backlog[].text` (required) - one line
- `factory_backlog[].from` (optional) - the run's own finding, or the person's feedback row
- `numbers.estimation_ledger_line` (required) - written|skipped
- `numbers.orchestrator_share` (required) - the share, and whether it exceeded retro.orchestrator_share_max
- `numbers.stages_out_of_order` (required) - any stage that finished before it started, with its stamps
- `delivery_bookkeeping.manifest_rebuilt` (required) - true|false
- `delivery_bookkeeping.post_s9_update` (required) - authorised|pending|not_applicable
- `delivery_bookkeeping.pending_paths` (optional) - the exact paths waiting, when gate B did not authorise this target
- `claims.every_trap_names_exactly_one_owning_document` (required) - true|false
- `claims.nothing_was_archived_by_a_role` (required) - true|false
- `claims.the_feedback_answer_is_verbatim_or_declined` (required) - true|false
- `claims.the_dashboard_was_rebuilt` (required) - true|false
- `tried[].requirement` (required) - the thing that went wrong or dear
- `tried[].technique` (required) - where you looked for the cause (the journal, a log, a record)
- `tried[].observation` (required) - what you found, in one line
- `tried[].evidence` (required) - the path (and anchor) where it shows
- `tried_note` (optional) - why the table is empty, or a dash when it has rows
- `unresolved[].id` (required) - obligation or fold row
- `unresolved[].reason` (required) - one of vocabulary.unresolved_reasons
- `unresolved[].detail` (required) - what exactly is missing, and what would settle it
- `blocked.field` (only when blocked) - the field of this file the role cannot fill
- `blocked.problem` (only when blocked) - what the role tried and what refused it, verbatim
- `blocked.tried[]` (only when blocked) - command or step, and its answer
- `blocked.data[]` (only when blocked) - path of anything the conductor needs to see

Every handoff form shares one skeleton (`common_shape` of handoffs/index.yaml): `inputs`, `inputs_read`, `header`, `scope`, `artifacts`, `claims`, `unresolved`, `blocked`.
